context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on operational rigor
purpose: Teach: 数量/要領/対談/補佐/試行錯誤/フォーマット/一昨年/当分

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 発注数量の管理、要領を覚えれば若手も育つ。
lines.en: Order quantity management—once the young staff grasp the fundamentals, they'll develop naturally.
lines.style: Measured, patient delivery. Unhurried pace with a deliberate pause after the dash. Voice carries quiet conviction without weight. The tone of someone who has watched this pattern repeat and trusts it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。補佐の人選も、当分慎重に進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're being careful about who we choose for the assistant role as well.
lines.style: Respectful, composed nod of the head in voice form. Even pacing, attentive—the steady tone of someone listening and responding with full presence. No rush, no decoration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 一昨年のフォーマット、見直しはしているか?
lines.en: Are you still reviewing the format from two years back?
lines.style: Direct inquiry, curiosity without urgency. Slight uptick on the question mark. The tone checks in—not demanding, genuinely curious whether the work is continuing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 試行錯誤を経て、来月にも刷新する予定です。
lines.en: After some trial and error, we're planning to roll out the new version next month.
lines.style: Clear conviction but not defensive. Straightforward tempo. The slight lift on 'next month' shows confidence in the timeline without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 対談形式のレビューも残しておけ。資産だ。
lines.en: Keep the dialogue-style reviews in place too. They're valuable assets.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Calm authority—the voice of someone whose few words carry experience. Slight emphasis on 'asset' as the point lands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, clean acceptance. Respectful finality. Brief exhale beneath the word—the sound of someone taking direction and holding it steady.
